outputs.DETERMINISM_NOTES: The repair is source-structural and deterministic. It contains no verifier-name, hidden-input, random test-case or environment-specific branching; solve.sh formats, tests and builds the repaired program after installation.
outputs.PRESERVED_BEHAVIOR: The public Go HTTP API, task metadata, Docker runtime, solver-visible fleet data, Ansible role surfaces and TypeScript dashboard remain intact while the approved transactional, reconciliation, rollout and concurrency invariants are restored.
outputs.RESTART_IDEMPOTENCY_BEHAVIOR: Repeated solve.sh execution applies the same root-cause repairs, formats and rebuilds the same Go program; durable state uses atomic rename plus directory fsync and startup marks incomplete historical transactions failed rather than replaying partial publication.
RESTORED_INVARIANTS: Canonical route identities collapse equivalent prefixes and ignore multipath ordering while preserving route-table identity.
Policy-rule effective priority is unique per node/family and lookup rules cannot reference absent tables.
Apply is fenced to the exact preview base revision and idempotency keys cannot be rebound to a different plan.
Desired, observed, transaction, idempotency and audit state publish atomically through one durable replacement with directory fsync.
Rollback restores each affected node's own prior snapshot as a new monotonic revision and refuses to overwrite newer state.
Reconcile refuses stale observed snapshots and never removes unowned unexpected routes or rules.
Rollouts stop at failed canaries, reject stale/offline heartbeats, and do not replay nodes already at target revision.
Ansible config projection is stable across reruns and preserves host-specific protected routes over group/default routes.
Dashboard Apply uses the immutable base revision returned by Preview rather than a concurrently refreshed UI revision.
RISKS_FOR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER: Exercise rollback after intervening revisions and verify conflict rather than clobber.
Exercise IPv6 aliases, multipath reorder and route replace normalization independently.
Exercise stale observed reconciliation and unowned-route preservation.
Exercise stale heartbeat, failed canary and rollout retry behavior.
Exercise Ansible rerun convergence and host-specific protected route precedence.
